issue.title: Next UI: Named type styles
issue.body:
Adds Figma's named type styles to the theme so Next components and screens stop using the Legacy size scale.

Figma: [Foundations · Type](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2308-6)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `theme.type` has all 9 styles (reading, readingStrong, heading, lead, title, body, label, overline, meta) with Figma's sizes, line heights, weights, `includeFontPadding: false` and uppercase where Figma sets it
- [ ] `theme.typeTelugu` carries the Telugu line heights, and `theme.fontScale.readingMax` the 1.3× cap
- [ ] Android keeps the 500 / 600 weights (no unloaded font family named)
- [ ] Added Legacy-first; the Legacy snapshot only gains keys
- [ ] Theme docs, the audit and the `figma-component` skill reflect it

Needs QA? No (nothing renders with these yet)

Follow-ups: the real font families are open (`open-questions.md` Q1).
